articles.title_en: OPENING THE FLOODGATES: PARTIAL AND GENERAL EQUILIBRIUM ADJUSTMENTS TO LABOR IMMIGRATION
articles.title_cn: 开启闸门：劳动力移民的部分与一般均衡调整
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the impact of a large immigration shock on occupational wages. We develop a general equilibrium model where individuals sort into occupations and confront testable hypotheses with data. To identify the effect of the labor supply shock, we introduce a novel instrument that exploits that immigrants systematically sort into different occupations than natives. We study the immigration wave to Norway after the Eastern enlargement and find that immigration led to lower relative occupational wages. A quantification of the general equilibrium shows welfare effects of immigration close to zero for natives, but negative effects for the pre‐existing population of immigrants.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究大规模移民冲击对职业工资的影响。我们构建了一个个体选择职业的一般均衡模型，并用数据检验可验证的假设。为了识别劳动力供给冲击的效应，我们引入了一个新颖的工具变量，利用移民与本地人在职业选择上的系统性差异。我们研究了东扩后挪威的移民潮，发现移民导致相对职业工资下降。一般均衡的量化分析显示，移民对本地人的福利效应接近于零，但对原有移民群体产生负面影响。

articles.abstract_en: We study the regulation of brokerage in wholesale markets in premodern Central Western Europe. Examining 1,804 sets of rules from 82 cities, we find brokerage was primarily a centralized matchmaking mechanism. Brokerage was more common in towns with larger populations, better access to sea ports and trade routes, and greater political autonomy. Brokers' fee structures varied systematically: price‐based fees were more common for highly heterogeneous goods, quantity‐based fees for more homogeneous goods. We show theoretically that this was broadly consistent with total surplus maximization, and that brokerage was more valuable in markets with unequal numbers of buyers and sellers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了前现代中欧西部批发市场中经纪业务的监管。通过考察82个城市的1,804套规则，我们发现经纪业务主要是一种集中化的匹配机制。经纪业务在人口较多、通往海港和贸易路线更便利以及政治自主权更大的城镇中更为普遍。经纪人的费用结构系统性地变化：基于价格的费用更常见于高度异质性的商品，而基于数量的费用则更常见于同质性较高的商品。我们在理论上表明，这与总剩余最大化大致一致，并且在买卖双方数量不等的市场中，经纪业务更有价值。

articles.title_en: THE IMPACT OF LOCAL FISCAL AND MIGRATION POLICIES ON HUMAN CAPITAL ACCUMULATION AND INEQUALITY IN CHINA
articles.title_cn: 地方财政与迁移政策对中国人力资本积累和不平等的影响
articles.abstract_en: We develop and estimate a spatial overlapping generations model with heterogeneous households to study the feasibility of a recently proposed reform of internal migration policies that offers the potential of decreasing inequality within China. We find that this policy change significantly increases the college attainment of migrant children born in rural areas and, therefore, promises to increase the number of high‐skill workers. However, it requires significant tax increases to offset the reduction of the positive fiscal externalities provided by migrants.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发并估计了一个包含异质性家庭的空间重叠世代模型，以研究最近提出的内部迁移政策改革的可行性，该改革有望减少中国国内的不平等。我们发现，这一政策变化显著提高了农村地区流动儿童的高等教育获得率，因此有望增加高技能工人的数量。然而，这需要大幅增税以抵消流动人口提供的正向财政外部性减少的影响。

articles.title_en: ENDOGENOUS PROCYCLICAL LIQUIDITY, CAPITAL REALLOCATION, AND q
articles.title_cn: 内生顺周期流动性、资本再配置与q
articles.abstract_en: Capital reallocation is procyclical and an economic boom has a cleansing effect by shifting the distribution of firms from low quality to high quality. We explain these facts by modeling search frictions for used capital in the business cycle. The article characterizes the stochastic equilibrium analytically to prove that the liquidity and the price of reallocated capital are procyclical endogenously. We calibrate the model and construct proxies in the data for the unemployment rate of capital and the time on the market. These two variables have a strong positive relationship in both the model and the data.
articles.abstract_cn: 资本再配置是顺周期的，经济繁荣通过将企业分布从低质量转向高质量而产生清洁效应。我们通过在企业周期中建模二手资本的搜索摩擦来解释这些事实。本文解析性地刻画了随机均衡，以证明再配置资本的流动性和价格是内生顺周期的。我们校准了模型，并在数据中构建了资本失业率和市场停留时间的代理变量。这两个变量在模型和数据中都具有强烈的正相关关系。

articles.title_en: ADVERSE SELECTION, LEARNING, AND COMPETITIVE SEARCH
articles.title_cn: 逆向选择、学习与竞争性搜寻
articles.abstract_en: I develop a model that allows for an analysis of the effects of time on adverse selection in the presence of search frictions. I find that, as a firm takes longer to adjust a worker's contract in response to learning about his type, inefficient overwork during the time before wage adjustment (probation) decreases. This provides a rationale for an optimal (minimum) probation period of about one month in the baseline scenario. Optimal probation duration varies with the degree of search frictions, the cost of effort, the relative productivity of different types of workers, and minimum wage regulations.
articles.abstract_cn: 我构建了一个模型，允许在存在搜寻摩擦的情况下分析时间对逆向选择的影响。我发现，随着企业在根据对工人类型的了解调整其合同方面花费更长时间，工资调整前（试用期）期间的低效过度工作会减少。这为基准情景下约一个月的（最低）试用期提供了合理性依据。最优试用期时长随搜寻摩擦程度、努力成本、不同类型工人的相对生产率以及最低工资规定而变化。

articles.abstract_en: This article shows how meeting frictions affect equilibrium trading mechanisms and allocations in an environment where identical sellers post mechanisms to compete for buyers with ex ante heterogeneous private valuations. Multiple submarkets can emerge, each consisting of all sellers posting a particular mechanism and the buyers who visit those sellers. Under mild conditions, high‐valuation buyers are all located in the same submarket, and low valuation buyers can be in: (i) the same submarket, (ii) a different submarket, and (iii) a mixture of (i) and (ii). The decentralized equilibrium is efficient when sellers can post auctions with reserve prices or entry fees.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文展示了在相同卖家发布机制以竞争具有事前异质私人估值的买家的环境中，会议摩擦如何影响均衡交易机制和配置。可能会出现多个子市场，每个子市场由发布特定机制的所有卖家以及访问这些卖家的买家组成。在温和条件下，高估值买家全部位于同一子市场，而低估值买家可能位于：（i）同一子市场，（ii）不同子市场，以及（iii）（i）和（ii）的混合。当卖家可以发布带有保留价格或入场费的拍卖时，分散均衡是有效的。

articles.title_en: PARENTAL TIME INVESTMENT AND INTERGENERATIONAL MOBILITY
articles.title_cn: 父母时间投资与代际流动性
articles.abstract_en: This article constructs an overlapping generations general equilibrium model to explore the extent to which heterogeneity in time investment shapes intergenerational mobility of lifetime income. The calibrated model successfully accounts for untargeted distributional aspects of income mobility. Counterfactual exercises show that removing heterogeneity in parental time investment reduces intergenerational persistence by around 7–8% for early childhood but only marginally in later childhood. Policy experiments find that an asset‐tested subsidy for parental monetary investments in early childhood can raise intergenerational mobility in a cost‐effective way, though it reduces mobility substantially if given to parents with older school‐aged children.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文构建了一个重叠世代一般均衡模型，以探讨时间投资的异质性在多大程度上塑造了终身收入的代际流动性。校准后的模型成功解释了收入流动性的非目标分布特征。反事实实验表明，消除父母时间投资的异质性会使早期儿童期的代际持续性降低约7-8%，但对后期儿童期的影响甚微。政策实验发现，针对早期儿童父母货币投资的资产审查补贴能够以成本有效的方式提高代际流动性，但如果给予有学龄较大子女的父母，则会大幅降低流动性。

articles.title_en: INTERNATIONAL CAPITAL FLOWS: PRIVATE VERSUS PUBLIC FLOWS IN DEVELOPING AND DEVELOPED COUNTRIES
articles.title_cn: 国际资本流动：发展中国家与发达国家的私人流动与公共流动
articles.abstract_en: Empirically, net capital inflows are procyclical in developed countries and countercyclical in developing countries. Private inflows are procyclical and public inflows are countercyclical in both groups of countries. The dominance of private (public) inflows in developed (developing) countries drives the difference in net inflows. We rationalize these patterns using a two‐sector model of a small open economy facing borrowing constraints. Private agents overborrow because of the pecuniary externality arising from these constraints. The government saves to reduce aggregate debt, making the economy resilient to adverse shocks. Differences in borrowing constraints and shock processes across countries explain the empirical patterns of capital inflows.
articles.abstract_cn: 实证上，净资本流入在发达国家是顺周期的，在发展中国家是逆周期的。私人流入在两组国家中都是顺周期的，而公共流入都是逆周期的。私人（公共）流入在发达国家（发展中国家）的主导地位驱动了净流入的差异。我们使用一个面临借贷约束的小型开放经济的两部门模型来合理化这些模式。私人主体由于这些约束产生的金钱外部性而过度借贷。政府储蓄以减少总债务，使经济对不利冲击具有韧性。各国之间借贷约束和冲击过程的差异解释了资本流入的实证模式。

articles.title_en: THE DISTRIBUTIONAL EFFECTS OF COVID‐19 AND OPTIMAL MITIGATION POLICIES
articles.title_cn: COVID-19的分配效应与最优缓解政策
articles.abstract_en: This article develops a quantitative heterogeneous agent–life cycle–epidemiological model that is used to study the aggregate and distributional consequences of COVID‐19 and mitigation policies. First, a stay‐at‐home subsidy is preferred to a lockdown because it reduces deaths by more and output by less. Second, Pareto‐improving policies can reduce deaths by nearly 45% without any reduction in output relative to no public mitigation. Finally, it is possible to simultaneously improve public health and economic outcomes, suggesting that debates regarding a trade‐off between economic and health objectives may be misguided.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一个定量异质性主体-生命周期-流行病学模型，用于研究COVID-19及缓解政策的总体和分配后果。首先，居家补贴优于封锁，因为它能更多地减少死亡，同时更少地减少产出。其次，帕累托改进政策可以在不减少产出的情况下，相对于无公共缓解措施，将死亡人数减少近45%。最后，可以同时改善公共卫生和经济结果，这表明关于经济与健康目标之间权衡的争论可能是有误导性的。

articles.title_en: INEQUALITY AND PANEL INCOME CHANGES: CONDITIONS FOR POSSIBILITIES AND IMPOSSIBILITIES
articles.title_cn: 不平等与面板收入变化：可能性与不可能性的条件
articles.abstract_en: Income changes in an economy are usually assessed through the changes over time in cross‐sectional variables such as economy‐wide inequality. An alternative is to use panel data to gauge income changes among identified income recipients. In this article, we analyze these two approaches taken together , each measured in multiple ways. We establish that under specific conditions, it is impossible to have falling inequality together with divergent panel income changes. We also provide conditions explaining when rising inequality can arise together with convergent panel changes. We provide the intuition behind these results and show when such results fail to hold.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济中的收入变化通常通过横截面变量（如整体不平等）随时间的变化来评估。另一种方法是使用面板数据来衡量已识别收入接受者之间的收入变化。在本文中，我们综合分析这两种方法，每种方法均以多种方式衡量。我们证明，在特定条件下，不平等下降与面板收入变化发散不可能同时发生。我们还提供了条件，解释何时上升的不平等可以与收敛的面板变化同时出现。我们提供了这些结果背后的直觉，并展示了这些结果何时不成立。

articles.title_en: GROUPED VARIATION IN FACTOR SHARES: AN APPLICATION TO MISALLOCATION
articles.title_cn: 要素份额的分组变异：对错配的应用
articles.abstract_en: A striking feature of microlevel plant data is the presence of significant variation in factor cost shares across plants within an industry. We develop a methodology based on cluster analysis to decompose cost shares into idiosyncratic and group‐specific components. We apply our methodology to Chilean plant‐level data and find that group‐specific variation accounts for approximately one‐third of the variation in cost shares. We study the implications of these groups in cost shares on the gains from eliminating misallocation. We place bounds on their importance and find that ignoring them can overstate the gains from eliminating misallocation by up to one‐third .
articles.abstract_cn: 微观层面的工厂数据的一个显著特征是，行业内工厂之间的要素成本份额存在显著变异。我们开发了一种基于聚类分析的方法，将成本份额分解为特质性和群体特定成分。我们将该方法应用于智利的工厂层面数据，发现群体特定变异约占成本份额变异的三分之一。我们研究了成本份额中这些群体对消除错配收益的影响。我们对其重要性设定了界限，发现忽略它们可能会将消除错配的收益高估多达三分之一。

articles.title_en: STORABLE GOOD MARKET WITH INTERTEMPORAL COST VARIATIONS
articles.title_cn: 跨期成本变化下的可储存商品市场
articles.abstract_en: We investigate a firm's dynamic pricing policy in a storable good market where the cost of production varies over time. In anticipation of a cost increase, the firm selects its prices to affect consumer storage. Price dynamics hinge upon the curvature of demand and the magnitude of the consumer storage cost. When demand is not too convex, the consumers' reluctance to store leads the firm to reduce prices to stimulate consumer storage. This shapes the firm's cost pass‐through and the price commitment effects. Our analysis provides a novel explanation for the well‐documented puzzling patterns of incomplete and negative cost pass‐through.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在生产成本随时间变化的可储存商品市场中，企业的动态定价策略。预期到成本上升时，企业通过选择价格来影响消费者的储存行为。价格动态取决于需求曲线的曲率和消费者储存成本的大小。当需求不是过于凸时，消费者不愿储存导致企业降低价格以刺激消费者储存。这塑造了企业的成本传导和价格承诺效应。我们的分析为有充分记录的、令人费解的不完全和负成本传导模式提供了新的解释。

articles.title_en: IRREVERSIBILITY AND MONITORING IN DYNAMIC GAMES: EXPERIMENTAL EVIDENCE
articles.title_cn: 动态博弈中的不可逆性与监督：实验证据
articles.abstract_en: This article provides experimental evidence on the impacts of irreversibility and imperfect monitoring on the efficiency and the equity of a repeated public goods game. We find that irreversibility and imperfect monitoring both lead to inefficient and unequal outcomes through different channels. Irreversibility lowers public goods contribution in earlier periods and makes the initial‐period contribution gap between two players long‐lasting. Imperfect monitoring hampers conditional cooperation and persistently reduces group contribution. A finite mixture estimation with conditional cooperators provides a coherent account of the treatment effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了关于不可逆性和不完美监督对重复公共品博弈效率与公平影响的实验证据。我们发现，不可逆性和不完美监督均通过不同渠道导致低效和不平等的结果。不可逆性降低了早期阶段的公共品贡献，并使两位玩家初始阶段的贡献差距长期存在。不完美监督阻碍了条件合作，并持续降低群体贡献。采用条件合作者的有限混合估计为处理效应提供了一致的解释。

articles.abstract_en: A university uses both early‐stage selection outcome (high‐school affiliation) and late‐stage admission test outcome (standardized test scores) to select students. We use this model to study policies that have been proposed to combat inefficient gaming in college admissions. Increasing university enrollment size can exacerbate gaming and worsen the selection outcome. Abolishing standardized tests for university admissions increases gaming targeting high‐school admissions and worsens the selection outcome, whereas eliminating high‐school ability sorting may improve the university selection outcome under some cost conditions of gaming. Committing to a lower‐powered selection scheme can improve the selection outcome by reducing gaming behaviors.
articles.abstract_cn: 一所大学同时使用早期阶段的选择结果（高中隶属关系）和后期阶段的入学考试结果（标准化考试成绩）来选拔学生。我们使用该模型研究为打击大学招生中低效博弈而提出的政策。增加大学招生规模可能加剧博弈并恶化选择结果。取消大学招生的标准化考试会增加针对高中招生的博弈并恶化选择结果，而消除高中能力分层在一定的博弈成本条件下可能改善大学选择结果。承诺采用较低效力的选择方案可以通过减少博弈行为来改善选择结果。
